blocks.text: Interferometer ek optical tool (aala) hai jo gravitational waves pakarne mein istemal hota hai. Yeh bohat sensitive (hassas) device hai jo LASER (Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) beams ka interference (waves ka aapas mein milna) istemal karta hai. Basic (bunyadi) Michelson interferometer Fig. 8.9 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

Gravitational waves pakarne wala interferometer LASER light se mirrors ke darmiyan faasle ki bohat hi chhoti tabdeeliyan napta hai, jo guzarti hui gravitational waves se hoti hain. Aise interferometers LIGO (LASER Interferometer Gravitational Wave Observatory) kehlate hain. LIGO aur conventional (aam) interferometer mein bare farq yeh hain:

items: LIGO conventional device se 1000 guna bara hai.
LIGO mein LASER hoti hai jabke conventional interferometer mein normal (aam) light ka source hota hai.

blocks.alt: Laser beam ko power recycling mirror se beam splitter tak bhejta hai, jo use oopar aur daen bhejta hai. Har arm mein input mirror aur end mirror hain, aur un ke darmiyan ki beam (surkh) Fabry-Perot cavity banati hai. Daen arm ke input mirror par 'Input mirror' likha hai. Wapas aati beams beam splitter se neeche ek be-label mirror se guzar kar photo detector tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.9: Basic Michelson interferometer (kitab ki Figure 8.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; 'Input mirror' ka label daen arm ke input mirror par lagaya gaya hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Laser ki beam beam splitter par do perpendicular arms mein bat jati hai. Har arm mein input mirror aur end mirror ke darmiyan light (roshni) baar baar aati jati hai (Fabry-Perot cavity), jis se rasta lamba aur device zyada sensitive ho jata hai. Wapas aa kar dono beams milti hain aur photo detector interference napta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.9 'Input mirror' ka label beam splitter aur photo detector ke darmiyan wale mirror par lagati hai, aur daen arm ka input mirror be-label chhorti hai. Input mirrors arm cavities ke shuru mein hote hain, is liye yahan label daen arm ke input mirror par hai. Photo detector se pehle wala mirror asal LIGO mein signal recycling mirror kehlata hai; kitab ka text us ka zikr nahi karta, is liye usay be-label rakha gaya hai.
Gravitational wave interferometer ke basic components yeh hain:

items: Laser: stable (mustaqil) aur high intensity (tez) light ki beam banata hai.
Power recycling mirror: jo LASER light instrument se guzar chuki ho usay baar baar wapas interferometer mein bhejta hai, isi liye “recycling” kehte hain.
Beam splitter: LASER beam ko do perpendicular beams mein baant deta hai.
Mirrors: beams ko reflect kar ke do perpendicular arms banate hain.
Fabry Perot cavity: aamne samne do mirrors; is ka kaam light ke raste ki length (lambai) barhana hai.
Photodetectors: wapas aane wali beams ko napte hain aur phase mein chhoti si tabdeeli (agar ho) pakarte hain.
Arm cavities: LASER light ko taqatwar kar ke instrument ki sensitivity (hassasiyat) barhati hain.

blocks.text: Laser beam do perpendicular beams mein bat jati hai; har beam interferometer ke do ek jaise paths (raston), yani arms, mein se ek mein jati hai. Beams har arm ke aakhir ke mirrors se takra kar wapas shuru ki jagah aati hain aur dobara mil jati hain. Agar gravitational wave guzre to mirrors ke darmiyan faasle mein bohat chhoti tabdeeli hoti hai, jis se dono beams ke darmiyan phase shift aa jata hai.

Dobara milne par beams interference pattern banati hain, jise photodetector napta hai. Gravitational wave ka chhota sa phase shift is pattern ko badal deta hai, aur detector wave ki presence (maujoodgi) pakar leta hai.

Figure 8.9 interferometer ki sab se saada shakal hai; asal mein yeh kahin zyada complex (pecheeda) hai. 14 September 2015 ko LIGO ne pehli baar universe (kaainat) ki gravitational waves pakrin. Einstein ne in ki prediction (peshgoi) 100 saal pehle ki thi; yeh waves do black holes ke takrane se aayi thin aur LIGO detector (USA) tak pohnchne mein inhein 1.3 billion (1.3 arab) saal lage. Gravitational waves ke observation par Rainer Weiss, Barry C. Barish aur Kip S. Thorne ko 2017 mein Nobel prize mila. Interesting (dilchasp) baat yeh hai ke team ki ek member, MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) ki professor Nergis Mavalvala, Pakistan se taalluq rakhti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne naam ghalat chhape hain: “Barisk” (sahi: Barish), “Throne” (sahi: Thorne) aur “noble prize” (sahi: Nobel prize).

LIGO ki tarah gravitational waves napne ki ek aur jagah Virgo hai, jo European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) ke under Pisa (Italy) ke qareeb Cascina mein hai. Virgo bhi interferometer hai, jis ke do arms 3 km ke hain jabke LIGO ke arms 4 km ke hain. Virgo observatory ka naam Virgo constellation (sitaron ke jhurmat) par hai, jo March, April aur May mein raat ke asmaan par nazar aata hai. Virgo cluster taqreeban 1,500 galaxies ka group hai jo taqreeban 50 million light years door hai. Ek light year (LY) woh faasla hai jo light ek saal mein tay karti hai; yeh taqreeban 9.5 × 10¹² km hai. Virgo ne gravitational wave events (waqiaat) pakarne mein hissa liya hai; us ki pehli detection 2017 mein hui.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ek light year “9.5 billion km” likha hai. Light ki speed 3 × 10⁵ km s⁻¹ aur ek saal taqreeban 3.16 × 10⁷ s hai, to 1 light year = 3 × 10⁵ × 3.16 × 10⁷ ≈ 9.5 × 10¹² km, yani 9.5 trillion (9500 billion) km.

blocks.title: Example 8.5
blocks.problem: Agar gravitational waves ki wavelength 4000 km ho to un ki frequency nikalein.
steps: Wave ki equation v = fλ, aur gravitational waves light ki speed se chalti hain (v = c)

blocks.title: Example 8.6
blocks.problem: Ek binary system 10⁻¹ Hz frequency ki gravitational waves kharij karta hai. In waves ki wavelength kya hai?
steps: f = 10⁻¹ Hz = 10⁻¹ s⁻¹, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, λ = ?
v = fλ aur v = c, is liye λ = c/f

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Michelson interferometer mein interference fringes (roshan aur andheri dhaariyan) banti hain.

blocks.alt: Ek gol manzar jis mein seedhi, mutawazi (parallel), barabar faasle wali khari dhaariyan hain, baari baari roshan peeli aur andheri.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 188): Michelson interferometer mein interference fringes (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peeli dhaariyan bright fringes hain jahan dono beams constructive interference karti hain, aur andheri dhaariyan dark fringes jahan destructive. Ek mirror ko sirf λ/2 hilane se raste ka farq λ badalta hai aur pattern ek fringe khisak jata hai, isi liye interferometer bohat chhoti doori bhi naap sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves pakarne ka basic method (tareeqa) kya hai, aur unhein pakarne ki kya importance (ahmiyat) hai (MCQ 8.12; constructed response 8.5)? Agar gravitational waves ki wavelength 3000 km ho to un ki frequency nikalein (numerical 8.11).
blocks.explanation: Laser interferometry: LIGO jaisa interferometer laser beam ko do lambe perpendicular arms mein bhejta hai aur guzarti wave se arms ki length badalne par chhota sa phase shift pakarta hai. Gravitational waves pakarna general relativity ki prediction ki confirmation (tasdeeq) karta hai, aur black hole mergers jaise events dikhata hai jo khud light nahi dete; is se universe dekhne ka naya darwaza khulta hai. f = c/λ = 3 × 10⁸ / 3 × 10⁶ = 100 Hz.

items: Interferometer: laser beam ko do perpendicular arms mein baant kar, reflect kar ke dobara milata hai; guzarti GW arms ki length badalti hai aur photodetector interference pattern mein phase shift pakarta hai.

Components: laser, power recycling mirror, beam splitter, mirrors, Fabry Perot cavity, photodetectors, arm cavities. LIGO (USA, 4 km arms) ne 14 September 2015 ko pehli waves pakrin; Virgo (Italy, 3 km).
f = c/λ: 4000 km par 75 Hz; λ = c/f: 10⁻¹ Hz par 3 × 10⁹ m.
